title: PR #117: docs: define end-to-end OS, kernel, AI and blockchain readiness gates
content:
State: closed
Merged: True
Draft: False

Closes #116

## Changes
- Add the end-to-end runtime roadmap for ShivaCore, GlobusOS, A-TownChain, ATC-VM, ATCLang and Aurora AI.
- Add a machine-readable readiness manifest with acceptance gates G0–G5 and a strict evidence-record schema.
- Preserve SSOT boundaries: this repository remains the integration/evidence control plane; implementation work stays in canonical source repositories.
- Explicitly prohibit treating merges or isolated green gates as end-to-end verification.

## Validation
- Documentation and YAML structure added; CI validation is still pending.
- All gates are initially marked BLOCKED because this change does not claim runtime verification.
- Draft PR; no auto-merge. Runtime implementation and exact-SHA evidence remain follow-up work.
